name: MigrationPro
summary: Shopify app that imports products, customers, orders, collections, URLs and 301 redirects from WooCommerce, Wix, Magento and 30-odd other platforms.
best_for: merchants moving an existing store into Shopify who want products, customers, orders and — critically — URLs and 301 redirects preserved, who are willing to pay the $29 add-on that carries those redirects on the self-service route, and who would rather pay once than subscribe to a tool they will use for a week
skip_if: you are migrating away from Shopify or between two other platforms, since this only imports into Shopify; or you want one firm number before you start, because the price still depends on your record counts and on which of the priced add-ons your source platform turns out to need; or you need to install from the Shopify App Store today, where the listing is not available as of 5 October 2026
honest_knock:
Start with what is no longer there. Read on 5 October 2026, the Shopify App Store listing says the app is not currently available and sends support questions to the vendor: no install button, no review page. The vendor's site is still live and still selling, and every install button on its homepage and pricing page still points at that listing, so ask them how you install before you plan a migration date around it.

When the listing was up it told you nothing about what this costs: “Free to install. Additional charges may apply”, and a single plan block saying pricing is tailored to the entities you migrate. The number lives on the vendor's calculator, and the first number you find there — $29 — is the floor for the smallest store on the self-service route, not the price for yours. Their own homepage says a typical store lands between $49 and $299. Run the calculator before you form an opinion about value.

The add-on structure used to be the unknowable part, and as of 18 September 2026 it is not: the pricing page lists every add-on with a price, from $19 to $39, and marks all of them included on the managed plan. That is a real improvement in what a buyer can read before committing. It also makes the self-service route look less like $29 — the 301 redirects add-on, which is the one thing a migrating store can least afford to get wrong, is a $29 extra on a $29 migration.

The marketing still runs ahead of the evidence. The pricing page says “Trusted by 250,000+ stores”, the homepage uses the same figure for migrations, and the FAQ says 250,000+ migrations over 13 years — one number doing three different jobs. The same page, and an FAQ answer saying the app is available on the Shopify App Store, still claim 5.0 from 170+ verified reviews, which nobody can check while the listing is down. On 18 September it showed 186, of which 181 were five-star, 4 four-star and one a single star. Those reviews were genuinely good; weigh them rather than the banner.

One practical limit sits in the reviews rather than the marketing. The FAQ says most stores finish in one to three hours and that 10,000+ products may take longer but still complete the same day, while a merchant migrating a very large catalogue in July 2026 wrote plainly that large volumes take a very long time and that the team helped speed it up. If you are moving tens of thousands of records, let the free demo and your own record count decide which of those two you are, not the FAQ.

pricing.notes: (re-read 2026-10-05 on apps.shopify.com/migrationpro-shopify-migration-app and migrationpro.io/pricing/) The App Store listing has gone. Read on 5 October 2026 it says “This app is not currently available on the Shopify App Store. If you have support questions, contact Migrationpro, LLC directly.” — no plan block, no install button, no review record — and its reviews page answers 404. On 18 September it still showed one plan, free to install, with the line that pricing is tailored to the entities you migrate and no subscription fees, billed in USD. The vendor's own homepage and pricing page are unchanged and still send every install button to that listing. The numbers live on the vendor's own pricing page, which quotes on your product, customer and order counts. Two routes are sold there, both one-time payments rather than subscriptions. The Automated app plan, where you run the migration yourself, starts at $29 based on store size. The Done-for-you plan, where their team handles mapping, testing and go-live with a dedicated specialist, starts at $300 with every add-on included. Both carry a 30-day guarantee, need no credit card, and begin with a free demo of up to 10 products, customers and orders. What has changed since 23 August is the add-on table: each one now carries a price. 301 redirects, order ID preservation, categories mapped to automated collections and content images are $29 each; customer groups to tags and default stock quantity are $19 each; spam customer detection, active products only and tax-inclusive pricing are $39 each; merging short and long descriptions, generating variants from options and resetting the target store are free. The homepage puts a typical store at $49 to $299 on actual record counts, and the FAQ says most stores finish in one to three hours, with 10,000+ products taking longer but still completing the same day. The app is English-only, migrates from WooCommerce, Wix, Squarespace, BigCommerce, Magento, PrestaShop, OpenCart, Shopware, Etsy, Amazon, CSV and Excel among others, and covers products, customers, orders, collections, images, URLs and 301 redirects, with Smart Sync to re-import data changed during the run. Developer Migrationpro, LLC, Dover, Delaware; the app launched 10 May 2022, and on 18 September 2026, the last time the listing was readable, it carried 186 reviews averaging 5.0 — 181 five-star, 4 four-star and one at a single star. Note that migrationpro.io/pricing without the trailing slash now answers 308.
